name: Notion
tagline: Flexible docs, databases, wikis, and lightweight project workspace

pricing.notes: Official pricing page checked 2026-07-30; public plan pages show Plus around $12/month monthly and lower annual price.

verdictSummary: A solo notes-and-database workspace is buildable, but Notion's block editor, permissions, sync, templates, AI, integrations, and collaboration take real product work.
coreLoopDIY: Build a block-based notes app with markdown-ish editor, simple databases, backlinks, templates, and local/cloud sync.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for a shared workspace that nontechnical teammates can trust and understand.

priorArt.name: AppFlowy
priorArt.desc: Open-source Notion-like workspace with databases and docs.

notes: Famous enough to be obvious, but its hidden editor/collaboration surface makes for an honest kinda.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Notion (Flexible docs, databases, wikis, and lightweight project workspace). Requirements:

- Core loop: Build a block-based notes app with markdown-ish editor, simple databases, backlinks, templates, and local/cloud sync.
- Needs: web app framework.
- Needs: database.
- Needs: auth.
- Needs: rich-text/block editor.
- Needs: optional LLM API.
- Needs: hosting.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: mature block editor; cross-device sync; permissions.
